title: A `yield` inside a `finally` block stops the build with an internal error.
text: `try { yield 1; } finally { yield 2; }` in a generator passes the checker, and the build then stops with `E0901` ("internal error: an operand used before it is defined"). So does a `finally` that is the only place with a `yield`. Either it compiles and yields, or it is a compile error with its own code where it is written. It closes when one of those is so, with a conformance case.
